sentences.text: PM-Daksh is a skill development scheme launched by the Government of India.
It aims to enhance the employability of marginalized sections of society.
The scheme focuses on providing skill training to youth from Scheduled Castes and other backward classes.
The primary objective is to empower these communities through skill development initiatives.
Benefits include financial assistance for skill training and access to various employment opportunities.
Eligible beneficiaries are individuals from Scheduled Castes and other backward classes.
The age limit for applicants is generally between 15 to 45 years.
The application process involves online registration through the official PM-Daksh portal.
Training programs are conducted by various training partners recognized by the government.
The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
Training is provided in various sectors based on market demand.
The frequency of training programs may vary based on the training partner and location.
The scheme also emphasizes the importance of entrepreneurship development.
Participants may receive assistance in starting their own businesses post-training.
Monitoring and evaluation are conducted to assess the impact of the training programs.
This initiative is part of the broader effort to promote skill development in India.
